note: News posts published by the Municipality of Labo on its own website, read through the site’s WordPress REST API as archived by the Internet Archive. Posts matching the injection blocklist are excluded; see `excluded` for every omission and its reason. Filtering is two-part: known injected content is rejected outright, and a post must also show a positive signal of being municipal news — a blocklist alone proved leaky.
